scenario: asking for help with health services & pharmacy
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Health Services and Pharmacy
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: health services & pharmacy — asking for help with health services & pharmacy
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with health services & pharmacy; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan asks Mr Thomas to help her understand medicine instructions.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nhờ anh Thomas giúp hiểu hướng dẫn dùng thuốc.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Thomas, can you help me understand these instructions?
turns.vietnamese: Thomas này, anh giúp tôi hiểu hướng dẫn này được không?

turns.speaker: Mr Thomas
turns.english: Yes, take one twice a day.
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ, uống một viên hai lần một ngày.
